detail.longDescription: I am brand-new to NiceGUI and I am trying to learn it for Python by following some tutorials to learn basic features. I have been trying to replicate the CSV file upload and show content by JCharistech: https://blog.jcharistech.com/2023/10/11/how-to-handle-file-uploads-in-nicegui-python/ I have tried to go through the steps he provided but even with the first example, the markdown file, I am getting an error. I am able to run the script and generate a nicegui webpage with the file upload option, and select the markdown file, but when I press the upload button I do not get the content on the webpage and instead get an error in my Powershell (that I ran the python script in). This is the code I am using: from nicegui import ui, app, events import pandas as pd from io import StringIO def handle_uploads(e: events.UploadEventArguments ): text = e.content.read().decode("utf-8") markdown_data.set_content(text) ui.upload(on_upload=handle_uploads).props("accept=.md").classes("max-w-full") ## show the content markdown_data = ui.markdown() ui.run(port=8081) And this is the error I get when I try to upload the markdown file: text = e.content.read().decode("utf-8") ^^^^^^^^^ AttributeError: 'UploadEventArguments' object has no attribute 'content' I do not understand what I am doing wrong and I would really appreciate some help please.
